description:
A tool library project in use, based on native C#, does not require any third-party libraries.
			This project features many practical functions, such as support for multiple Base encoding types, common operations for files/folders, high-precision timers, encryption, etc.
			Some comments and documents are generated by artificial intelligence based on the code. If there are any mistakes, please provide feedback in time and we will correct them as soon as possible.
releaseNotes:
- Rename "QingYi.Core.String" to "QingYi.Core.Codec".
			- Support Deflate compression.
			- Support LZ77 compression.
			- Optimize the Base10 encoding and decoding implementation.
			- Support encryption and decryption-related functions (DES/AES/TripleDES).
			- Support .NET 5.
			- Use new icon.
			- Support Base128.
title: QingYi.Core
